Class Clown.name: Class Clown
Class Clown.description:
🤡 You were the one who made the whole class laugh.

🗣️ You talked your way out of every detention.
🎭 You can sell a story with a straight face.

📈 Grants: Deception +5, Persuasion +5
Class Clown.traitNarrativeEffects: The character was the class joker: pranks, impressions and quick excuses. They read a room fast, defuse tension with a joke and can sell a story with a straight face.
